planner.title: Best planner
planner.rule: Highest Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index overall.
planner.reason: Highest Intelligence Index in the catalog at 50.51.
planner.caveat: Not zero-retention according to the published terms.

builder.title: Best cheap builder
builder.rule: Cheaper than the planner and within 10 Intelligence Index points of it; best intelligence per dollar.
builder.reason: 42.79 Intelligence Index at $2.25 blended per 1M tokens, versus 50.51 at $4 for the planner.

medium.title: Best for medium tasks
medium.rule: Highest Intelligence Index among models at or below the median blended price of rated models.
medium.reason: 36.62 Intelligence Index at $0.125 blended, at or below the rated median of $0.48750000000000004.
medium.caveat: OpenCode lists this model as training on requests. Do not send sensitive data.

cheapest.title: Cheapest capable
cheapest.rule: Lowest blended price among models with an Intelligence Index of at least 25.
cheapest.reason: $0 blended per 1M tokens with an Intelligence Index of 32.4.

private.title: Most private
private.rule: No training on requests, zero data retention, and an Intelligence Index of at least 30.
private.reason: 46.55 Intelligence Index with no training on requests and zero data retention.
